questions.prompt: 160bb, button, folded to you with 76s. Compared with 40bb, you should…

choices.text: Open more happily. You can win a big pot if you flop a straight or two pair.

questions.explanation: Depth is the reason this hand is playable in position.

questions.prompt: 150bb, you have KTo in the small blind facing an early open. Best default?

choices.text: Fold. You are dominated, out of position, and deep.
Call and stack off top pair
Complete because you posted a blind

questions.explanation: Reverse implied odds are the point of this fold.

questions.prompt: 140bb, you flop top pair weak kicker on a wet board, multiway. Best default?

choices.text: Pot-control. Do not build a 140bb pot with this hand.
Fold the best hand to a min-bet with no read

questions.explanation: Weak kickers and depth do not mix in a big pot.

questions.prompt: You have a set at 180bb on a dry board. Best default?

choices.text: Bet for value across streets. You are not forced to jam the flop.
Open-shove the flop for 180bb every time

questions.explanation: Depth lets you get more from worse hands by betting, not by ending the hand immediately.
